notes.title: 『Eldritch Survivors』Official Release Patch Notes
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439226/c7059b36bb479f30b0ef5c893fdcc594954736bf.jpg

Survive the Unknown Horrors and Endless Cycle of Death! 
At last, Eldritch Survivors has officially released!

Thanks to the interest and feedback from our users, we were able to reach full release.
Thank you!
With the official release, we'd like to inform you of the following changes.

[Overall Gameplay Flow Improvements]
 ◈ Guides have been added for various in-game systems.
　- When important information is needed for progress, the game will be paused,
　　and a guide popup will be displayed.
　- Once viewed, you can recheck the guide popup through [ESC Menu] → [Game Guide].

◈ The quest segments where progress resets have been removed to
　make story progression easier.
　- Based on Nathan's choice after crafting the device, when progress is reset due to choices, 
　　the reset has been changed so that it will restart to the previous quest.
　- Based on Nathan's choice, while crafting the device or the quest for defeating
　　the gatekeeper in the dungeon, even if the Ruin Gauge at the top right reaches 100%,
　　your current game progress will now be retained.
　- Once the scenario is fully completed, Challenge Quests will be unlocked.
　　(1) Users who finish all the main quests will receive challenge quests.
　　(2) The challenge quests consist of a total of 4 quests 
　　　  and must be completed before the Ruin Gauge at the top right reaches 100%.
　　(3) If the Ruin Gauge hits 100% before completing all challenge quests, 
　　　  The challenge quests must be rechallenged from the beginning.

◈ To provide more motivation during gameplay, 
　the Exploration Report's unlocking order and reward order has been adjusted.
　- The unlock timing of most relics and spells has been moved to be unlocked earlier.
　- From the mid-game, new conditions requiring playthroughs of the second 
　　and third dungeons have been added in the Exploration Reports.

◈ Acquiring relics has been made to be significantly easier.
　- The number of relics you can obtain in a single dungeon run has increased to 2.
　- To make relic acquisition easier, the in-dungeon location of relics has been adjusted.
　　※ However, relics tied to story progression are excluded from this adjustment.

◈ The cost of permanent upgrades and dungeon difficulty has been adjusted to
　better support new users and gradually provide more motivation for users.
　- To help new users unlock weapons more easily, the crafting costs for S.H.I.e.L.D 
　　and EAGLE weapons have been reduced.
　- To make relic growth a more defined gameplay goal, 
　　 The cost to awaken relics to stages 4 and 5 has been slightly increased.
　- To match the perceived value of spell upgrades, the cost of spell research has been reduced.
　- The Blackspring Forest dungeon's early difficulty and boss difficulty have been eased
　　to help new users adapt more easily.
　- Great Mushroom Swamp and Withered Forest will become gradually more difficult 
　　depending on relic unlock progression, with the adjustment of the monster's attack power
　　and HP.

[Content Additions]
◈ Special abilities are added to each character to enjoy more diverse gameplay.
　(1) Abigail
　- When flowers are obtained, movement speed temporarily increases.
　- Has the widest field of view among all characters.
　(2) Nathan
　- When a monster is defeated, the critical rate increases. However, it resets upon damage.
　- Has the highest Critical Hit Additional Damage among all characters.
　(3) Lisa
　- Recovers Sanity when Madness is obtained.
　- Less burden when using magic.
　(4) Luther
　- Evasion rate increases when standing on Rough Terrain.
　- Has the highest Rough Terrain Resistance among all characters.

◈ New relics are added.
　- Relics are added that allow refresh by the following choice options.
　　(1) Enhancement options
　　(2) Mother of Everything option
　　(3) Intervention of Cosmos option
　- A relic is added that probabilistically blocks Madness from triggering.
　- The effect of The Elder Sign necklace is changed from 
　　increasing the number of times until the monster returns 
　　to increasing Critical Hit Additional Damage.

◈ Steam achievements are added.
　- 19 achievements are added to serve as gameplay objectives.

[Dungeon Gameplay and Balance Improvements]
◈ Early combat speed is improved to feel less sluggish.
　- Movement speed of characters is increased.
　- Initial Attack Speed of weapons crafted by Nathan is significantly increased.

◈ Other balance aspects are adjusted in line with the increased movement speed.
　- Rough Terrain Resistance given in the Mother of Everything is reduced.
　- Movement speed reduction in Rough Terrain is increased.
　- The movement speed of powerful monsters that the Intervention of Cosmos gives options
　　to is increased.
　- Difficulty of Trials is adjusted:
　　(1) Monument's HP is increased.
　　(2)  The number of monsters to defeat on top of the mark is increased.
　　(3) Survival time in the trace of the ritual is increased.

◈ Game tempo has been improved to be more enjoyable.
　- To speed up the tempo of each round, powerful monsters 
　　that give Intervention of Cosmos options spawn 1 minute earlier.
　- To avoid time feeling too tight during boss battles, bosses spawn 1 minute earlier.
　- If powerful monsters are left undefeated for too long,
　　their movement speed gradually increases.
　- After surviving past the 5-minute time limit, as a last chance,
　　 An escape portal spawns in a random location.
　　※ However, orbs earned from this escape portal are fewer than those 
　　　 from a portal spawned after clearing all Trials.

◈ The low growth of basic weapons is adjusted.
　- Final Damage is slightly added to the enhancement option for all basic weapons.
　- For enhancement options that previously increased Final Damage,
　　the increased amount is increased for the options that reduced Final Damage,
　　the reduction amount is decreased.

◈ Overperforming stats related to Stagger and Movement Speed Reduction have been adjusted.
　- The EAGLE Shock Module Specialization was overly powered, 
　　so the stagger time of the explosion zone is reduced.
　- The reversed Territory Magic now reduces movement speed less than before.

◈ Certain Intervention of Cosmos had higher or lower DPS than intended, 
　so their performance was adjusted accordingly.
　- Ghatanothoa's Whispers: Attack power is reduced.
　- Rhogog's Fragment: Attack power is increased.
　- Shadow of Chavalios: Attack power is increased.
　- Ithaqua's Footsteps: Attack power is reduced.
　- Juk-Shabb's Dance: Attack and explosion power are reduced.
　- Cthuga's Wrath: Attack power is reduced.
　- Hypnos' Dreams: Attack power is reduced.
　- Abhoth’s Uncontrollable Power: Attack speed increase is reduced.
　- Abhoth’s Overwhelming Power: Explosion radius increase is increased.

◈ Certain short-range, high-damage Cosmic Interventions had lower DPS than intended, 
　so their performance is adjusted.
　- LRP No.4 Automation Mod
　　(1) When the specialization is selected, it no longer reduces range.　
　　(2) Final Damage reduction is decreased, making it stronger.
　- S.H.I.e.L.D Vibration Module Equipped
　　(1) The explosion radius reduction is decreased, making it stronger.
　　(2) Chain attack intervals are reduced, making it explode faster.
　- EAGLE Rapid Fire Mod
　　(1) The explosion radius reduction is decreased, making it explode bigger.
　- KAMERA Burst Shot Update
　　(1)After selecting a length increase specialization option,
　　　 an option to increase the length for KAMERA will appear.
　- Nodens's Swift Blessing
　　(1) The distance between the blessing and character is increased to hit a wider area.
　　(2) The number of blessings increases when specialization is selected.

◈ When the count increase option is excessively selected, a problem occurs where performance drops, 
　Therefore, the damage caused by the quantity of options has been adjusted.
　-  Ghatanothoa's Turbulent Whispers
　　(1) Quatanotha's Whisper quantity increase option's Final Damage is increased.
　- Tsathoggua's Numerous Altars
　　(1) Tsathoggua's Altar quantity increase option's Final Damage is increased.
　- Eihort's Expanded Games
　　(1) Eihort's Games quantity increase option's Final Damage is increased.

◈ To enhance the appeal of less popular specializations, the following changes will be implemented.
　-  Haster's Razor-Sharp Garment
　　(1) Adjusted so the Garment moves a certain distance forward to attack more enemies in front.
　　(2) The continuous damage is removed and changed to deal more damage simultaneously.
　- Chavalios’ Tenacious Shadow
　　(1) The attack speed is increased.
　　(2) The Final Damage reduction amount is decreased, making it stronger.

◈ To enhance the appeal of less popular specializations, the following changes will be implemented.
　-  Haster's Razor-Sharp Garment
　　(1) Adjusted so the Garment moves a certain distance forward to attack more enemies in front.
　　(2) The continuous damage is removed and changed to deal more damage simultaneously.
　- Chavalios’ Tenacious Shadow
　　(1) The attack speed is increased.
　　(2) The Final Damage reduction amount is decreased, making it stronger.

◈ The magic balance is adjusted to be used more evenly, according to the situation.
　- When on top of Dimensional Osmosis Barrier Magic, the character becomes invincible.
　- The Sanity cost of Spatial Banishment is reduced.
　- The Sanity cost of Space-time Tracking is reduced, 
　　and the chance to not consume Sanity is decreased.
　- The Sanity cost of Death Denial is reduced, 
　　and the chance to not consume Sanity is decreased.
　- The damage when the Monument of the Summon G'harne Monolith Magic explodes is
　　reduced.
　- The Reversed Territory Magic now has unlimited duration, and when used again, 
　　the previously created zone disappears.
　- The Visualization of Le Ruyé Magic has its damage dealt to bosses(%) reduced.

[Graphics & Visual Effect Improvements]
◈ The overall concept of the village is improved to help immerse users in the world.

◈ Shading is added to characters, and volume is enhanced.

◈ The monsters' textures are refined and improved to make them feel sturdier.

◈ An effect where fragments are generated when monsters die is added 
　to enhance impact and immersion at the moment of a kill.

◈ The size of weapons, which previously looked relatively small, has been adjusted to be larger.

◈ Colors, shapes, and sorting order of effects are refined to appear cleaner and more intuitive.

◈ Attack and death sounds for ranged monsters are added.

◈ General and death-related sounds for powerful monsters are added.

◈ Sounds are added for pattern monsters.

◈ A sound is added when a character enters the dungeon entry portal.

◈ An effect is added when dying due to a Madness Death choice.

◈ A reward effect is added when defeating powerful monsters or Flying Polyps.

◈ An effect is added when obtaining a Relic.

◈ An effect is added when overcoming a trial or successfully escaping.

◈ An effect is added for situations with favorable probability:
　- When many orbs drop from a flower
　- When Sanity is not consumed upon using magic
　- When surviving by selecting the right choice in a Madness Death option
　- When a Flying Polyp appears

◈ The village changes depending on the Ruin Gauge at the top right.

[Cognition Improvements]
◈ An exclamation mark will notify you when each content element has new features unlocked
　or completed.

◈ For story dialogue, the notification will be changed to a speech bubble icon instead
　of an exclamation mark.

◈ The skill icon will display the amount of Sanity consumed.

◈ Improved so that Madness's activated and deactivated states 
　can be more easily checked from the Sanity gauge.

◈ Improvements are made to recognize dodges and critical hits more easily.

◈ The reward icons in the Exploration Report have been changed 
　to their corresponding item icons for easier recognition.

◈ Improved so that stat changes based on the selected option in choices can be checked.

◈ Improved so that character and weapon stats can be checked in the ESC menu.

◈ The map image and icons have been changed in the ESC menu to enhance visibility.

◈ A legend has been added to the map to identify the purpose of each icon.

◈ Reward information will be added under the trial information on the right, so that rewards 
　for trial quests can be checked in advance.

[Others]
◈ Improvements are made so that pressing ESC can skip dialogue and cutscenes.

◈ Additional cats will appear in the village.

◈ Improvements are made so that characters do not take damage when unable to move upon revival.

◈ Improvements are made so that after deaths due to Madness, characters revive with more health.

◈ Improvements are made to fulfill the Paranoia Madness flower acquisition conditions through
　the KAMERA.

◈ An issue where various letters appeared abnormally small in the UI is fixed.

◈ Improvements are implemented to resolve the issue of movement halting when
　multiple choices appear.

◈ Improvements are implemented so that choices appear more naturally.

◈ Some settings features are added and improved.
　- Improvements are made so that volume can be adjusted by mouse dragging.
　- Improvements are made to display the volume percentage.
　- A mute function is added.
　- A gamma reset function is added.
　- When adjusting gamma, the change is applied more naturally and smoothly based on sensitivity.
　- The position of display mode and resolution is changed.
　- A Vsync On/Off function is added.
　- A 60 FPS limit On/Off function is added.
　- When changing language, a game restart process is added.

◈ Awkward moments in dialogue progression are improved.

◈ Various expressions are added during conversations with characters according to the situation.

◈ When scenario choices appear, the image from the previous screen 
　will be displayed to help with the scenario immersion.

◈ Hit detection areas of some monsters are adjusted in favor of the player.

◈ The range for acquiring flowers is slightly increased.

[Data Reset]
As previously announced in a past developer note, previous data will be reset with the official release.

Due to issues that cannot be resolved, such as changes in quest order, exploration report order, 
and relic unlock order, we ask for your understanding that a data reset is unavoidable.

Once again, we apologize.

[Future Updates]
We will proceed with updates for the following items that many users have requested as soon as work progresses:

◈ Auto Aim
 ◈ Controller, Steam Deck Integration
 ◈ Key Mapping Function
 ◈ Support for resolutions other than 16:9

Once again, thank you for all the attention and love you've shown to Eldritch Survivors,
and we ask for your continued interest and support.

Thank you.

notes.title: 『Eldritch Survivor』 Hot Fix.250321
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439226/c7059b36bb479f30b0ef5c893fdcc594954736bf.jpg


  Improved GPU usage
 └ We have confirmed that users have been experiencing issues related to high GPU usage.
 └ The FPS limit has been set to 60 to improve system stability.
 └ This measure prevents the GPU from being used close to 100%,
　ensuring the game's overall performance and stability.

 Bug Fixes
 └ The issue where movement keys occasionally stopped working
　during gameplay when pressing the arrow keys after the choice UI appeared
　and was closed following a selection has been fixed.

notes.title: 『Eldritch Survivors』 Official Launch Update Preview
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439226/c198922d7cc46667d35029c63c630f40aa8cad61.jpg

Hello, and greetings!
This is Ghost Button from the Eldritch Survivors development team.
​
We sincerely thank you for all your interest and feedback regarding Eldritch Survivors.
​
Thanks to your support, we could clearly identify areas where the game needed improvement.
​
Our development team has compiled the feedback over the past few days,
and we aim to incorporate as much of it as possible by the official launch date on April 17(thu).
​
However, please note that since many changes will be implemented,
all your saved data will also be reset upon the official launch.
​
The following modifications are explained below, but please be aware that based on user feedback,
some changes may be added or adjusted before the official launch.
​
Added Guides & Balance Improvements

In many survival games, when characters become too powerful,
players can often clear the game with little effort, which rewards their growth and hard work.
However, if this occurs too often it can significantly diminish the game's appeal.
​
Therefore, Eldritch Survivors aims to avoid creating situations where
players can clear the game without effort.
This is the reason why we have intentionally kept permanent growth in areas like
attack power to a minimum and place more emphasis on movement-related mechanics.
​
However, these changes have led to increased fatigue for players in the dungeon.
Although many new elements have been added to Eldritch Survivors,
the absence of adequate learning design has resulted in a frustrating experience for players.
​
We aim to preserve the unique gameplay of Eldritch Survivors
while enhancing any inconvenient aspects.
Additionally, we will include a one-time guide that clearly informs players
about new elements and gameplay tips.
​
We will increase movement speed to prevent it from feeling sluggish
and adjust various balances accordingly
(for example, the reduced movement speed in rough terrain).

Permanent Growth Elements & Story Progression Improvements

We've become so immersed in the concept that many aspects of the game
have been designed to be uncomfortable and unfriendly.
​
Dungeons can cause players fatigue, and the town's progression can also feel tiring,
causing some uncomfortable moments.
​
We will work to improve permanent growth elements
and story progression to make the experience as comfortable as possible.
​
Monsters Resetting Progress will be used solely for story presentation.
Even if monsters appear during resource gathering or boss fight phases,
we will ensure that progress will not reset.
​
In one of the story choices, after collecting 2,000 materials,
if players select a specific option, their quest will revert to the [1/5] 700-item collection quest.
This has been changed to guide them to the [5/5] 2,000-item collection quest.
​
After the post-true ending section, the concept of returning progress
will be moved to a challenge unrelated to the main progress.
​
Relics will obtained more easily.
Acquiring relics without entering the dungeon would require too many changes.
​
As an alternative, we will adjust the locations during
dungeon progression to make it easier to acquire relics naturally.
​
​We will add NPC icons in specific situations
to help players recognize when they can interact with an NPC.
​
(1) When weapons, magic, or relics are unlocked,
and (2) when it's possible to receive exploration report rewards.
We will change the text to make the quest objectives more straightforward.
​
​We will also simplify the text regarding targets influenced
by permanent growth elements to make it straightforward.

New Content Added

We will add special abilities for each character to make their differences more noticeable.
​
We will introduce the functions of relics that were previously marked as upcoming:
1. A relic that probabilistically prevents the activation of madness.
2. A relic that allows players to reroll their choices.
​
Additionally, we will add several new achievements to the game.

Additional Changes and Improvements

1. Allowed the viewing of weapon stats when displaying options when pressing ESC in the dungeon.
2. Clarified how stats change based on selected options to enhance understanding of choice impacts.
3. Changed the settings UI more user-friendly and convenient.
4. Added explanations for each map icon to clarify their meaning and function.
5. Improved the flow of options displays and exits
　 to prevent discomfort or awkwardness during interactions.
6. Changed the "feel good" moments in the game to be more enjoyable and occur when
 (1) Evasion rate and critical hits occur.
　(2) When using magic does not consume the sanity bar.
　(3) Surviving madness death scenarios by selecting the correct option.
　(4) Displaying options after leveling up.
　(5) Completing dungeon quests.
　(6) Defeating bosses or successfully escaping.
　(7) When flying polyps appear.
7. Improved map visibility for easier navigation.
8. Improved the art quality of the village, characters, and monsters.
9. Added more expressions to character portraits in dialogues for a more dynamic experience.
10. Added elements that enhance cosmic horror's eerie and unsettling atmosphere.
11. Added a few more cats to the village.
​
​
We apologize for being unable to address the following issues
in this update due to the volume of feedback we've received.
These areas will be prioritized for improvement after we refine the core gameplay:
​
1. Support for resolutions other than 16:9
2. Support for auto-play functionality
3. Keymapping support
4. Gamepad support
​
Additionally, we plan to implement a hotfix as soon as we fix issues such as characters
being unfairly hit while standing still during selection or any GPU-related improvements.
​
Thank you

notes.title: 『Eldritch Survivors』 Early Access Launch
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439226/2d52270da1c11eed71c272c43b170837b58233e0.jpg

Survive the Unknown Horrors and Endless Cycle of Death!

The highly anticipated Eldritch Survivors Early Access is finally here, starting on March 13th, 2025!
Thank you for your patience and passionate support.

As a token of our appreciation, we're offering a generous 25% discount for two weeks to mark the Early Access launch!
Don't miss out on this exclusive opportunity, and seize the moment to immerse yourself in the world of Eldritch Survivors.

◈ Key Features of Eldritch Survivors

- Survive the Unknown Horrors: Survive the ever-changing stages and face powerful Cthulhu-inspired monsters!
- Magic Research & Weapon Upgrades: Strengthen and customize various weapons and spells to create your own combat style!
- Uncover Each Character's Hidden Story: Unravel the tangled secrets behind each character and uncover the hidden truth.
